# Gallery Page Instructions

Use [gallery-page](../../.agents/skills/gallery-page/SKILL.md) for project scope, page structure, ordered media, navigation and verification.
Resolve message and project identities using the [content naming map](../../.agents/skills/i18n/references/content-naming.md).
Verify actual route and media paths rather than deriving them from translated titles.
Preserve supplied order, distinct project/image navigation and complete photo access.
Keep translated captions, image arrays and navigation reactive and do not change viewer selection merely because labels recompute.
Update only the affected project and genuinely adjacent links.
Read [content direction](../../.agents/docs/content-direction.md) for optional descriptions and factual boundaries.
Check actual loaded media and unchanged-width locale switching; an SSR placeholder does not establish either.
